category_title: Students with limited expressive language who use visual supports and exhibit avoidance behaviors
minimal_context: Evan is expected to participate in a 30-minute whole-group calendar activity using a SmartBoard to review the date, days of the week, and weather.
dialogue:
TUTOR: It is time for our whole-group calendar activity. Let's look at the SmartBoard to review the date, days of the week, and the weather.

STUDENT: (Stands still and does not follow the direction to join the group activity.)

TUTOR: Evan, you need to come over here and participate with the class.

STUDENT: (Protests the activity by turning and running away from the calendar area.)

TUTOR: Please stop running and come back to the SmartBoard.

STUDENT: (Continues running and elopes into the unoccupied adjacent classroom to avoid the group activity.)

options.A: Probe the student to consider multiple plausible answers about the calendar; deliberately step back from being the single source of knowledge.
options.B: Instruct the student to first share information with a partner about the calendar before selecting volunteers to share with the group.
options.C: Provide a visual schedule that identifies the activities of the day and the reinforcers the student is eligible to receive.
options.D: Have the student write on the SmartBoard by tracing along the screen with their finger during the calendar activity.
